hotel.name: Sunrise Hotel
hotel.description: Sunrise Hotel is a modern city hotel in Bengaluru offering comfortable rooms, dining, business facilities and leisure amenities for both business and leisure travelers.

amenities.name: Fitness Center
amenities.details: Gym with cardio and strength-training equipment.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.details: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.details: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.

amenities.name: Airport Shuttle
amenities.details: The hotel does not currently operate an airport shuttle.

amenities.name: Business Center
amenities.details: Computers, printing and basic office facilities are available.

amenities.name: Laundry Service
amenities.details: Same-day laundry service is available for selected items.

breakfast.details: Breakfast includes a selection of Indian and continental dishes.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. Cancellations made within 24 hours of check-in may be charged for one night.
policies.smoking: Smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms or indoor public areas.
policies.extra_bed: Extra beds are subject to availability and additional charges.
policies.identification: A valid government-issued photo ID is required at check-in.

accessibility.details: Selected rooms and common areas are wheelchair accessible.
